title.en: When is Diesel 60 the off-grid pump to name?
title.zh: 什么时候点名柴油60作为无电网泵？

description.en: When the comparison is 35 m³/h, 144 kW and 150 m / 350 m, and the site has no stable grid. Do not use LZ-60’s 50 m³/h table under the same code string.
description.zh: 对照的是 35 m³/h、144 kW 和 150 m / 350 m，且现场没有稳定电网时。不要在同一个代号下改用 LZ-60 的 50 m³/h 表。

h1.en: When is Diesel 60 the off-grid pump to name?
h1.zh: 什么时候点名柴油60作为无电网泵？

directAnswer.en: When you need the printed 35 m³/h trailer and not the LZ-60 table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132 at 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 350 m and 3500 kg for sites without stable grid power. LZ-60 prints the same code string at 50 m³/h, 100 m conveying and 300 m height. Off-grid does not allow you to mix those rows.
directAnswer.zh: 当你要的是已印的 35 m³/h 拖泵，而不是 LZ-60 那张表。邢台河北品锦机械把柴油60 / HBT60-13.132 列为 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 350 m、3500 kg，用于电网不便的工地。LZ-60 用同一串代号印了 50 m³/h、输送 100 m、高度 300 m。没有电网也不能把两行混用。

heading.en: Step up only when 35 m³/h is the cell you mean
heading.zh: 只有你指的就是 35 m³/h 时才上这一档

body.en: Diesel 50 is 30 m³/h and 150 m / 450 m. Diesel 60 shortens the vertical cell to 350 m and raises output to 35 m³/h and engine power to 144 kW. If the vertical run needs the longer 450 m listing, Diesel 50 may still be the closer distance row even though output is lower. Send both constraints.
body.zh: 柴油50是 30 m³/h、150 m / 450 m。柴油60把垂直格收到 350 m，把输送量提到 35 m³/h，发动机提到 144 kW。如果垂直管路需要更长的 450 m 列出，柴油50的距离行可能更接近，尽管输送量更低。两个限制都要发。

heading.en: Electric low-pressure 60 is the grid machine at 35 m³/h
heading.zh: 电动低压60是 35 m³/h 的电网机器

body.en: It prints 75 kW, 35 m³/h and three stone rows for building placement. Same 35 m³/h does not make it a diesel pump. No grid means you do not rename it. You open Diesel 60 or another diesel page.
body.zh: 它为建筑浇筑印了 75 kW、35 m³/h 和三行石子。同样是 35 m³/h，也不会把它变成柴油泵。没有电网时不要给它改名。去打开柴油60或其他柴油页。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Paste the Diesel 60 URL if you want 35 m³/h rather than LZ-60’s 50 m³/h. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 如果你要的是 35 m³/h 而不是 LZ-60 的 50 m³/h，请贴上柴油60的地址。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: What is the hydraulic pump cell?

answer.en: Not on the Diesel 60 specification list. LZ-60 prints 4 cm and below on its own page.
answer.zh: 柴油60规格表上没有。LZ-60 在自己的页面上印了 4 cm 及以下。

question.en: Is 3500 kg the same as Electric 60?

answer.en: Diesel 60 prints 3500 kg. Electric 60 prints 3300 kg and is a 90 kW grid pump at 40 m³/h.
answer.zh: 柴油60印 3500 kg。电动60印 3300 kg，是 90 kW、40 m³/h 的电网泵。

alt.en: Diesel 60 off-grid trailer pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery at 35 cubic metres per hour
alt.zh: 河北品锦机械柴油60型无电网拖泵，理论输送量每小时35立方米
